schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 012 - Panel Visibility Persistence

questions.label: Should currently open plugin panels persist after app restart?
questions.help: Recommended: persist last visible panels globally, but not per workspace. This keeps the app feeling durable while respecting user-global plugin layout preferences.
options: Yes, persist last visible left/right panels globally
No, restart opens with no plugin panels visible

questions.label: When switching chat sessions, should visible panels change?
questions.help: Recommended: keep the same visible panels, but panel content follows the active chat session. This matches per-session plugin instances without making layout jump around.
options: Keep visible panels; content follows the active chat session
Restore visible panels from each chat session
Close plugin panels on session switch

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether panel widths persist, whether hidden enabled views stay warm, or whether mobile/narrow windows should reset panels.
